svg.title: Likelihood, posterior, and four intervals for the repair rate
svg.desc: One panel for the twenty-job gamma study: the relative likelihood and the posterior density over lambda, with the Wald, likelihood-ratio, exact and posterior intervals drawn underneath on the same axis.
svg.text: Twenty jobs, total 120 hours: what the data say about lambda
All four cover 0.5. The three frequentist intervals differ by about 0.01 at each end; the posterior one is shorter and pulled
toward the prior mean of 0.4, and it is the only one whose endpoints are read off a distribution for lambda itself.
